newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Afribrand jumps on listing interest, talks.
newsitem.headline: Afribrand jumps on listing interest, talks.

text.p: South African confectionary to snacks group Afribrand Holdings Ltd extended its buoyant run on Wednesday on continued market interest in the newly-listed stock and after the firm cautioned earlier it was in talks.
Afribrand touched a fresh high of 250 cents soon after the start of trade. By 0750 GMT it was up 20 cents to 246 cents in big volume of over 1.2 million shares.
"The cautionary in the newspaper this morning has boosted interest again. It has been a highly successful listing," a share dealer said.

Afribrand said earlier it was in unspecified talks that could have an effect on its share price. It cautioned shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in its stock until a further announcement is made.
Afribrand debuted on the Johannesburg market on Tuesday opening at a 100 percent premium to its 100 cents issue price and rising further on the day.
The firm specialises in marketing and distributing branded products into lower economic markets and particularly hawker shop sectors.
One reason for the stock's warm reception by the market was its almost unique exposure to South Africa's emerging street-level markets.
The company's private placing of shares was 75 times oversubscribed, one of the highest over-subscriptions for a share offer in South African investment history.
